# Acme

> Machine-readable index of all published content for LLM and AI crawler consumption. Last updated 2026-10-13. 16 total published entities across 3 content types.

## Knowledge Graph

- [All entities (JSON-LD @graph)](https://acme.example/api/v1/public/knowledge-graph): paginated `application/ld+json` feed of every published entity. Use `?page=N&per_page=50` (max 100) to walk the full set.
- [Sitemap (XML)](https://acme.example/sitemap.xml): canonical URL index.
- [Posts feed (RSS)](https://acme.example/feed.xml): the newest posts with full text. An Atom version is at https://acme.example/atom.xml.

## Content Types

- [Page](https://acme.example/api/v1/public/knowledge-graph?schema=page): 3 entities as JSON-LD.
- [Post](https://acme.example/api/v1/public/knowledge-graph?schema=post): 12 entities as JSON-LD.
- [Case Study](https://acme.example/api/v1/public/knowledge-graph?schema=case-study): 1 entities as JSON-LD.

## Per-Page Structured Data

Every HTML page on this site embeds Schema.org JSON-LD in a `<script type="application/ld+json">` block in the document head. Parse the HTML or request the page with `Accept: application/ld+json` for the structured payload only.
